name: deep-search
title: Deep search
description: Answer broad or multi-part questions from the NAS knowledge base with a planned, step-by-step search: break the question into sub-queries, search each, read only new material, and cite every source.
examples: List every Lunar Lake processor in my docs, sorted by model number
Compare the memory specs of the i7-1255U and the i7-1355U from my spec sheets
What do my notes and reports say about the 2025 budget, across all documents?
author: Nimo
